acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params._guardian: Address authorised to call emergencyPause().                      Separate from owner so pause authority can be held by a                      hot wallet / monitoring bot while ownership stays cold.
params._owner: Initial contract owner — receives ownership directly.                      Never defaults to msg.sender; must be supplied explicitly.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

DISPUTE_TIMEOUT().notice: After releaseTime + DISPUTE_TIMEOUT, anyone may trigger a release on a         Disputed agreement even without arbiter action, protecting against arbiter         inaction or loss-of-key. Set to 30 days.

renounceOwnership().notice: Ownership renouncement is permanently disabled.         The owner is required to unpause the contract; renouncing while paused         would permanently lock out new agreement creation with no recovery path.
